claims.text: Delayed puberty: a short course of low-dose testosterone (boys) or estrogen (girls) is often started when delayed puberty and growth cause substantial psychosocial stress.
claims.quote: A short course of treatment with low doses of testosterone for males or estrogen for females is often initiated when puberty and growth cause substantial psychosocial stress and low self-esteem for a child.

claims.text: Girls: low-dose 17β-estradiol (oral or transdermal patch) is the preferred initial tx;
claims.quote: In females, a low-dose 17-beta estradiol preparation (oral or transdermal patch) is the preferred initial treatment.

claims.text: estrogen is ↑ over time until breakthrough bleeding or 12–24 mo of tx,
claims.quote: Estrogen is also used incrementally over time until breakthrough vaginal bleeding occurs or 12 to 24 months of treatment have passed.

claims.text: then combined estrogen + progesterone keeps normal monthly withdrawal bleeding;
claims.quote: The recommendation is then for patients to start combination estrogen and progesterone therapy to maintain normal monthly withdrawal bleeding.

claims.text: oral estrogen + progesterone, or transdermal estrogen + oral progesterone, are more physiological than OCPs.
claims.quote: Commonly used hormone replacement therapies include oral estrogen plus progesterone or transdermal estrogen patches with oral progesterone; both combinations are more physiological than oral contraceptive pills.
